episodes.title: He Found a Notebook That Could KILL Anyone… 📓 | Death Note #Shorts
episodes.hook: One name. One death. That's all this notebook needs.
episodes.cta: Hero or villain? Would you write a name? Follow Otaku Reframe for part two.
episodes.script: One name. One death. That's all this notebook needs. Light Yagami finds the Death Note, and thinks it's a cruel prank. Then he writes a criminal's name while watching the news. Forty seconds later... the man drops dead on live television. Maybe a coincidence? Light tests the notebook one more time. Another death. And now he knows the rules are real. So he chooses to punish criminals, believing he's creating a better world. But here's the terrifying twist: the notebook wasn't lost by accident. Ryuk, a bored god of death, dropped it just to entertain himself. He appears in Light's room, expecting fear. But Light has a different plan. He vows to become the god of a new world. Kira is born. Hero or villain? Would you write a name? Follow Otaku Reframe for part two.
